race.comment: Several win chances but LUNAR VISTA (3) looks awfully close to a win. Fitter for two runs back and just missed last time in a richer maiden. Extra trip a plus and back at home. Looks hard to beat. FARTOO FRISKY (12) had a lot go wrong last time in the same race as LUNAR VISTA. Was back and wide and failed to come on. Fitter, better draw, extra trip a plus, change of rider and blinkers added. Might see a different horse. RED RIPPLES (4) has been thereabouts without winning and should run well again. SNOBBERY (7) hasn't raced since the Victorian St Leger as a three-year-old. Has placed 3/6 and while might be better over further, class might take him a long way here fresh back in maiden grade. RICH MELODY (5) looks next best.
